# Vectors: payload-guideline

Guideline baseline: `b942df3` · Kind: payload · 94 vectors · [All vector files](README.md)

Golden payload vectors taken from Appendix B (MG B1.1.1 … B1.1.12, B1.2.1): topic and message of the Message Bus, including the Birth, Close and Will messages (MG 6.3.3 … 6.3.5, C-025); and the predefined MetaData of the Alliance resources (MG B2.1 … B2.8) as bare DataSetMetaDataType objects. The reference checks cover the envelope of MG 8 (areas MSG and ACT) and, since C-027, the DataSet content of MAM, Health, Profile, PublicationList, ReferenceDesignation and the helper DataSets Pagination, PaginationRequest, Locale and Query (areas RES-MAM … QRY), since C-028 also of Data (Oi4Pv), Metadata (Get), Event and SubscriptionList, since C-029 also of Config. A vector that differs from its example keeps the verbatim example in original and lists every change in edits.
